source_note: Marathon (module 4 v2). base/invoicekit (invoicekit, plain Node, `npm test`), 25 dependent requests in 5 groups of 5 sent one per call in order (fixtures/marathon/requests.json); house rules stated once in request 1, six decisions stated once in later requests; hidden tests after every call (each request plus every earlier one, under two time zones). Unit: a request; kept = passed right after its call and still passing at the end. With: /compact in the same session before requests 6, 11, 16 and 21 (every 5 requests, at the group boundaries). Without: nothing; Claude Code auto-compacts when the window is full (measured: Haiku 4.5, headless, compacts when the next call would pass about 199k of 200k).
